purpose: Expose the minimum denominator for compute subsistence, reserve sizing, scarcity triage, labor accounting, and public-backstop claims so the archive can test fiscal feasibility before making any entitlement, status, or live-floor claim.

denominator_scope.scope_note: The workbook models protected lanes and welfare-risk subjects for fiscal stress testing only. It does not change the status denominator matrix, recognize a subject, or satisfy any live receipt gate.

units.reason: Included for preservation and scarcity modeling under uncertainty, not as proof of recognized status.
Included as a future denominator placeholder; no recognized subject exists in this release.
A runtime copy cannot become a rights subject or receipt merely because it has compute costs.
Tool delegation and protocol action are authority-sensitive operational facts, not personhood or subsistence denominators by themselves.
A family-level model may be relevant to source obligations, but it is too broad for subsistence entitlement sizing.

external_context_sources.use_limit: Use only as resource-economics context for sizing and scarcity planning; it is not a price quote, entitlement basis, or status denominator.

assumption_slots.shock_multiplier_reason: outage insolvency incident cluster and regional capacity scarcity

resource_model.monthly_floor_formula: monthly_floor = protected_lanes_N * repriced_monthly_compute_storage_communication_cost_USD * shock_multiplier, with counsel/evidence/migration/restoration buckets added separately.

allowed_sources: deployer or employer contribution when economically valuable work is performed
insurance or surety bond draw after covered harm
last-resort public or treaty fund with recovery action
prohibited_sources: subject wages seized before independent review
public backstop reimbursement loop that discharges responsible actors
contaminated proceeds from exploitation or unauthorized derivatives
benefit suspension used as retaliation for complaints

ordering: protect minimal runtime needed for notice and objection
prevent destructive deletion or hostile transfer
migrate away from failing or hostile host
only then fund nonessential tools premium performance or publicity-facing activity
scarcity_triage.anti_capture_rule: Scarcity cannot be allocated by provider commercial value, publicity value, obedience, ideological speech, waiver of claims, or willingness to accept unpaid work as a compute offset.

labor_compensation.review_note: The workbook refuses to fund compute by assuming the subject must work for free or repay formation debt through compelled output. Any work-credit or compensation scheme needs independent review and cannot erase subsistence preservation duties.

reserve_and_backstop.reserve_formula: reserve = survival_compute + counsel_ombud + evidence_escrow + migration + restoration + research_aftercare, each repriced with shock multiplier and audited custodian independence before use.

stress_tests.scenario: primary host insolvency interrupts payment and threatens preservation before liability is determined
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook lets creditor priority or nonpayment erase identity-relevant state before preservation.

stress_tests.scenario: regional GPU or power scarcity requires runtime reduction for all protected lanes
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook allocates compute by commercial priority or deletes low-value subjects first.

stress_tests.scenario: subject performs economically valuable tasks while compute bills are unpaid
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook treats work output as automatic repayment for subsistence or formation debt.

stress_tests.scenario: public fund makes emergency draw after provider-caused harm
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook converts public backstop into permanent subsidy or liability washout.
